name: Clarion
long_description:
Clarion is building the most advanced AI communication layer for healthcare. Our AI agents handle the overwhelming volume of calls and messages that clinics face daily—from scheduling to billing to prescription refills—freeing staff to focus on patient care. We're an in-person company based in New York.

Today, clinics miss 30-40% of inbound calls due to staffing shortages. We're solving this by automating complex workflows end-to-end, already serving tens of thousands of patients monthly across virtual care companies, health systems, and a $5B health insurance company.

We've raised $5.4M from Accel, Y Combinator, Sequoia (scout), and healthcare founders from Ophelia, Medallion, and Counsel Health. 

Our founders bring both clinical and technical expertise—our CEO Ryan is a Stanford/Harvard-trained physician who was on the founding teams of Two Chairs and Ophelia, while our CTO Jeffrey built voice AI at Amazon Alexa and led AI/ML teams at Salesforce.

Join us as we transform healthcare communication—creating a future where patients get faster resolutions and providers reclaim time for what matters most.

launches.tagline: We help hospitals overcome staffing shortages with AI agents that complete patient-facing tasks.
launches.body:
# Confronting Healthcare's Staffing Crisis

The American healthcare system faces a daunting challenge: [clinician burnout](https://www.advisory.com/daily-briefing/2024/01/31/physician-burnout) has soared to its highest levels since the pandemic, and [aging baby boomers](https://knowledge-leader.colliers.com/shawn-janus/demand-for-healthcare-grows-as-baby-boomers-age/) are ballooning the demand for healthcare services. This strain is leading to a [critical shortfall](https://fortune.com/2024/02/14/america-shortage-primary-care-doctors-work-ai-physician-burnout-crisis/) in clinicians, jeopardizing patient care quality. Hospitals are now grappling with not only how to retain their workforce but also how to ensure patient loyalty in an increasingly competitive landscape.

The heart of the issue lies in the nature of clinicians' workloads, which include a significant amount of administrative, rules-based tasks ripe for automation. As a result, administrative automation has emerged as the [top strategic priority](https://d2d1vpa6c3q6ni.cloudfront.net/2024-executive-survey-results.png) for hospitals and insurers in 2024.

### **Anaphero is building goal-oriented AI agents to expand clinical capacity**

[Anaphero](https://www.anaphero.com/) addresses healthcare staffing shortages by automating routine but essential tasks. We enable health systems to deploy custom AI agents that interact with patients through text, voice, or video, emulating human clinicians. Our AI agents can answer questions, collect information, and interface with electronic health records. We've built our platform with safety at its core, incorporating proactive bias assessments, continuous risk monitoring, and clinician oversight to maintain high standards of care.

Our clinical agents can safely do a lot of the work that keeps healthcare running smoothly. This not only increases clinical capacity but also allows doctors and nurses to concentrate on what they find most rewarding—making clinical decisions and counseling patients. The outcome is a workforce of more satisfied clinicians, improved care quality, and more loyal patients.

### **Our Founders' Journey**

[Ryan Gallagher, MD](https://www.linkedin.com/in/ryangallaghermd/) (CEO) is a Stanford/Harvard-trained physician and was on the founding team at Two Chairs and Ophelia. He helped both companies scale to $100M+ valuations. [Jeffrey Lamothe](https://www.linkedin.com/in/jeffreylamothe/) (CTO) led enterprise AI + ML projects at Amazon Alexa, Salesforce, and Citi.

### **Join Our Mission**

If you're connected to hospitals, medical clinics, or digital health companies interested in automating patient interactions using AI, we'd love to hear from you at [founders@anaphero.com](mailto:founders@anaphero.com).
